title: Storefront UI inventory (v0)
description: Output of apps/storefront/scripts/ui-inventory.mjs, committed at specs/design-system/ui-inventory.json. Every JSX call site of a component that comes from a UI package (or from src/ui) with directory, file, line and column, plus the props written at that site. Built with a parser (TypeScript compiler API or @babel/parser with the jsx+typescript plugins), never with grep. The totals are the gate of every migration wave: `directImportsOutsideUi` must reach 0 before the ESLint rule flips to error. Architect, 2026-09-06.

root.description: Scanned directory relative to the repo (apps/storefront/src).

files.description: Files with at least one entry.

imports.description: Import statements (one per file per package).

directImportsOutsideUi.description: Import statements of @medusajs/ui or @medusajs/icons in files outside src/ui/**. The wave gate.

component.description: Name as exported by the package (Select, Select.Trigger, ChevronDown).

kind.description: jsx = used as a tag; call = called as a function (clx); type = type-only import.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

props.description: Literal prop values as written; a non-literal expression is recorded as the string "<expr>"; a spread as "<spread>".

parent.description: Nearest enclosing JSX tag name, when any.

clientComponent.description: File starts with the "use client" directive.

route.description: For files under src/app: the route segment path.
